summary.motive: Flood the deep zones with five defenders while rushing only four, baiting offenses into the seams and erasing them with the Mike linebacker’s unique deep-middle conversion.
summary.keyDefender: MIKE turning his hook-curl drop into the deep-middle hole — the only defender who can erase both seams
summary.whyItWorks: Underneath-first corners contest every quick throw instantly, forcing the QB to hold for seams — exactly where the sprinting Mike arrives.
summary.failureMode: A fast deep-middle flood of post-seam combinations occupying the Mike before he can turn and run.

beats.title: 1. The MOFC Two-High Picture
beats.text: Only four men rush while both corners squat at 10-plus yards and the safeties split the halves. The middle of the field belongs to one man: the Mike linebacker.

beats.title: 2. Seams Attacked on Both Halves
beats.text: Both slots stem vertically into the classic Cover 2 seams — the void between the squatting corner and the safety half — while the QB climbs his five-step drop.

beats.title: 3. Mike Turns and Runs the Hole
beats.text: Reading the lock-on, the Mike converts his hook-curl drop into a dead sprint toward the back-center hole, erasing the seam the coverage is built to bait.

beats.title: 4. Back-Center Interception
beats.text: The seam throw sails directly into the sprinting Mike’s dive at the landmark — the signature Tampa 2 moment that turned picks into points.

relations.tell: Both corners squat at 10 yards staring at the QB instead of trailing receivers vertically — cloud keeps its boundary corner pressed at 1 yard.
